violations.message: RiskReport must link at least one evidence id.

input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic regional hospital ICU reported that the device failed to flag a clinically significant ventricular tachycardia episode in real time. Two independent overnight telemetry reviews and the cloud-side classifier log all confirm a documented, sustained ventricular tachycardia episode that was missed at the time; a second, structurally identical miss was confirmed in a separate patient on the same software version, establishing recurrence across the deployed population. The device confidence-score log, the retrospective clinician read, and the raw waveform export are all consistent.

risk_report.rationale: The device failed to flag a clinically significant ventricular tachycardia episode in real time, with confirmed recurrence across the deployed population (SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE). This represents a realized serious patient-safety risk, as missed detection of ventricular tachycardia can lead to severe harm or death. The confirmation of recurrence establishes a broad deployed-population exposure to this risk.  The device's failure to perform its intended function requires review under EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.1 regarding electronic programmable systems and their repeatability, reliability, and performance (mdr-annexI-sec17.1-electronic-programmable). The software development lifecycle must be reviewed in accordance with the state of the art, including risk management and verification/validation (mdr-annexI-sec17.2-software-lifecycle).  The incident also triggers obligations under 21 CFR § 820.10(c) concerning design controls for devices automated with computer software (qmsr-820.10-c-design-development), specifically related to ISO 13485 clause 7.3. The device's IT security measures also require review, as a failure in the classifier could be linked to unauthorized access or other vulnerabilities (mdr-annexI-sec17.4-it-security).  The device confidence-score logs for both missed episodes (ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2025A, ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-2029A) confirm the failure and provide data for investigation.
